description: This file defines the class Vtiger_PDF_InventoryContentViewer, which extends Vtiger_PDF_ContentViewer to generate inventory content views in PDF format, including header setup, cell drawing, page management, and watermarking.

classes.name: Vtiger_PDF_InventoryContentViewer
classes.description: A class for rendering inventory content in PDF format, with methods for initializing display, drawing borders, handling multi-page content, and adding watermarks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes cell widths and sets up the inventory content viewer.

methods.name: initDisplay
methods.description: Sets up the PDF header and content frame for inventory data.

methods.name: drawCellBorder
methods.description: Draws borders around cells, optionally with specified heights.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Controls the display flow, including pre-last page and last page rendering.

methods.name: displayPreLastPage
methods.description: Handles rendering of inventory items across multiple pages, managing overflow and summaries.

methods.name: displayLastPage
methods.description: Finalizes the last page, including footer and watermark.

methods.name: drawStatusWaterMark
methods.description: Adds a 'created' watermark to the PDF.
